# BB00323 {.unnumbered}

Praise be to God Who hath created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them in truth; and His command is nearer than that He should say unto it, "Be", and it is.

Unto God belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Say: All shall return unto Him.

Unto God belongeth the splendour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-glorious, all-glorious.

Unto God belongeth the radiance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-illuminating, all-illuminating.

Unto God belongeth the effulgence of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-luminous, all-luminous.

Unto God belongeth the majesty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, majestic, majestic.

Unto God belongeth the beauty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, beautiful, beautiful.

Unto God belongeth all greatness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, most great, most great.

Unto God belongeth all glory and loftiness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-great, all-great.

Unto God belongeth all might in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, mighty, mighty.

Unto God belongeth all power in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, powerful, powerful.

Unto God belongeth all wisdom in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, wise, wise.

And unto God it pertaineth that, in every domain and in each house, there be of times and seasons a place wherein the verses of God are inscribed, that men may dwell therein and that mercy may be shown unto the people, that haply God may exalt the station of him (who thus serveth); for He hath ever been forbearing, all-forbearing.

Unto God belongeth the knowledge of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-knowing, all-knowing.

Unto God belongeth the judgement of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, One Whose judgement is nigh at hand.

Unto God belongeth the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a light all-luminous.

Unto God belongeth all power in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-powerful, all-powerful.

Unto God belongeth the word of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a word acceptable and well-pleasing.

Unto God belong the entreaties and supplications of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Well-Beloved, the Well-Beloved.

Unto God belongeth the honour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of an honour tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all sovereignty in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, a Sovereign, Most Great.

Unto God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a dominion tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Kingdom (malakút) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, a King, Most Bountiful.

Unto God belongeth the exaltation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Most High, the Most High.

Unto God belong the signs of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, manifest, all-glorious.

Unto God belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, a Keeper, a Keeper.

Unto God belongeth all mercy in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, merciful, merciful.

Unto God belongeth all forgiveness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-forgiving, all-bountiful.

Unto God belong the wondrous realities of the entire Cause, in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a Cause all-glorious.
